title: Isle of Man · executive (head of state)
system: the monarchy is hereditary; lieutenant governor appointed by the monarch; chief minister indirectly elected by the Tynwald for a 5-year term (eligible for second term)
winner: Lord of Mann King CHARLES III; represented by Lieutenant Governor Sir John LORIMER (since 29 September 2021)
